unproven.name: AuthoredPlugin
unproven.reason: authored-changes.tsx types component props with it, and each value it types comes from authored(), which platejs/authored drops, so no case can build one against Plate.

unproven.name: BlockInsertOptions
unproven.reason: It types tx.blocks.insert's options, which the documented calls pass inline without naming the type.

unproven.name: CreateEditorOptions
unproven.reason: No Plite doc, README or example names the options type; the documented calls pass createEditor and useEditor options inline.

unproven.name: definePlugin
unproven.reason: No Plite doc, README or example imports definePlugin from plitejs/react, so no case can cite a call. platejs/react binds it to another function than platejs's, which the root cases check.

unproven.name: EditorLeaf
unproven.reason: Docs name it only in prose lists of rendering primitives, and no doc, README or example page shows a call.

unproven.name: EditorText
unproven.reason: Docs name it only in prose lists of rendering primitives, and no doc, README or example page shows a call.

unproven.name: Plugin
unproven.reason: Named only in the export list and editor.mdx's signature, never in a call.

unproven.name: PluginReference
unproven.reason: Named only in the export list and editor.mdx's signature, never in a call.

unproven.name: TransferPlugin
unproven.reason: Plite exports it as the type of transfer()'s descriptor, Plate as a value, and no Plite doc calls it.
